name: Night at the Edge of Daybreak: A Short Visual Novel
source:
Two lesbian vampires have a conversation about the loss of someone they both loved.

[From [url=https://ashleecraft.itch.io/night-at-the-edge-of-daybreak]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
两位女同吸血鬼围绕着那位她们曾共同深爱却已逝去的故人，展开了一场促膝长谈。

[摘自[url=https://ashleecraft.itch.io/night-at-the-edge-of-daybreak]itch.io[/url]]
